items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Zutty Singleton interacting with or knowing Phil Gonsalves; the mention of Phil is in a story told by the Interviewer about Paul Gonsalves.

ctx.x: Well I said to Phil (Gonsalves?) one night, I was talking, no I won't say what I was talking about,
but I said, 'well he's a drag.' And Paul said, don't use slang expressions like that around me Stanley.
